thread:
pagerbot: INCIDENT detected · kv_cache heartbeat surge + continuous-batch growth in prod-us-east-1 for qwen-mqa-13b.
pagerbot: metric: kv_cache.evictions 18x baseline, cont_batch.queue_length up 12x, p50 gen latency up ~3x, increased 5xx on inference proxies. Auto-detection at 2024-05-08T14:17:56Z. Paging alice_oncall.
alice_oncall: acked — hopping in. rough scope? any customer-facing errors yet?
leo_support: seeing customer A and customer B report spike in tail latency and occasional 502/503s on text-generation route. Telemetry shows retries from SDK increase. Not widespread  but steady.
maria_ml: quick note — this looks model-variant specific. Qwen MQA path shows prefix-KV growth (per-token key size) after the recent runtime kernel tweak. MQA's KV heartbeat is stalling and causing continuous batching to pile up prefixes.
raj_infra: copying logs from affected shard:
```
[2024-05-08T14:15:12Z] shard-12 kv_cache: prefix_keys=1.2M -> 9.6M (5m), evict_rate spike, contbatch_inflight 68 -> 420
[2024-05-08T14:16:03Z] runtime: backpressure applied, enqueue latency > 200ms
[2024-05-08T14:16:55Z] proxy: 503 upstream timeout for model=qwen-mqa-13b shard=12
```
raj_infra: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable prefix KV caching for qwen-mqa-13b on affected shards, 2) force continuous-batch max_batch_size=8 and max_wait_ms=5 for the model route, 3) scale up fallback capacity if needed.
alice_oncall: can we hotpatch config via admin API? if so let's do per-shard patch to avoid global churn.
raj_infra: yes — using runtime-admin v2. patch payload below (applies to shard-12 and shard-13):
```
PATCH /admin/runtime/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "qwen-mqa-13b",
  "shards": [12,13],
  "overrides": {
    "kv": { "prefix_cache_enabled": false },
    "batching": { "max_batch_size": 8, "max_wait_ms": 5 }
  }
}
```
raj_infra: running now. rolling to shard-12...
deploy-bot: rollout-started model=qwen-mqa-13b shards=[12] user=raj_infra ts=1715240201
raj_infra: applied to shard-12, verifying evictions and queue.
leo_support: initial signs good — p50 trending back down on shard-12 within 90s. customer A latency reduced, errors went from ~7% -> ~0.8%.
maria_ml: confirming this aligns with hypothesis — prefix cache growth was the root cause. disabling prefix cache prevents unbounded key accumulation for MQA variant.
alice_oncall: apply same to shard-13, then watch for cross-shard fallback. raj_infra, do you want me to push or you?
raj_infra: pushing to shard-13 now.
deploy-bot: rollout-complete model=qwen-mqa-13b shards=[12,13] status=success ts=1715241320
anya_sre: nice mitigation. next steps: 1) customer notification draft, 2) create incident ticket and assign postmortem, 3) short-term telemetry alert to detect prefix growth before evictions exceed threshold.
leo_support: customer comms: recommend proactive note to Customer A and B: short blip, mitigated, root cause related to MQA prefix caching after runtime kernel change. cc engineering SLA inbox.
alice_oncall: preparing handoff notes for next oncall (end of shift in ~45m). Summary for next-oncall: 
- incident id: kv-heartbeat-regression-1715239876
- affected: qwen-mqa-13b, shards 12/13 in prod-us-east-1
- impact: customers A/B saw 502/503 and elevated latency, ~60–120s windows, overall traffic partially degraded until per-shard patch applied.
- mitigation applied: disabled prefix KV caching on shards 12/13, set batching overrides (max_batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=5).
- diagnostics: KV key cardinality grew ~8x, contbatch queue length jumped, hotspot on MQA-specific path tied to kernel optimization that changed heartbeat pacing.
- runbook references: /confluence/runtime/kv-eviction-and-batching (link), postmortem ticket will be created.
anya_sre: assigned follow-ups: 
- raj_infra: create reproducible test in staging (simulate MQA prefix growth) || due: 2024-05-09
- maria_ml: evaluate model-side guardrails to prevent unbounded prefix growth (prompt eval + heartbeat alignment) || due: 2024-05-12
- infra: add alert: kv.prefix_cardinality > 5M for > 2m on a shard -> P2
- support: send customer note and SLA impact log || due: asap
raj_infra: created staging test and PR for a kernel fallback default; link: internal/pr/4523 (will link in ticket).
leo_support: draft for customers posted to #customer-comms, please review.
alice_oncall: ok i'm handing off to anya_sre for the overnight. key watch items for next oncall: watch prefix_cardinality, contbatch queue length, p50 token latency for qwen-mqa-13b.
anya_sre: taking the handoff. I will keep 30m post-deploy monitoring then escalate if regressions return. please ping me directly if you see >1% 5xx or prefix growth resumes.
alice_oncall: thanks team. final: incident status -> mitigated, monitoring. :thumbsup:
anya_sre: acknowledged — filing incident ticket now and scheduling postmortem sync. closing thread when postmortem created.
